data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'sergios', meaning 'guardian' or 'protector'. This name was given to those who served as soldiers or were in charge of important duties. In Christianity, St. Serge was a Roman soldier who converted to the faith and is now a patron saint of soldiers, converts, and Russia. The name Serge carries the meaning “Serious, guard, protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Serge usually hope their child will grow to embody serious, guard, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
